items.title: Chester Jones Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: I asked the man who wanted to teach me music, Joe Nichols. He liked my playing so much. He said, come now and I'll show you and I'll learn you a lot about it.

ctx.x: I asked the man who wanted to teach me music, Joe Nichols. He liked my playing so much. He said, come now and I'll show you and I'll learn you a lot about it. Him, he made the offer to me and another guy made an offer to me. He stayed to Old Falls to play a crowd. Connick. He saw, he had charge of this, what you call this band they had up around here, the welfare, was it?
Oh I know what you're talking about, when they had the WPA band.
